title: Design exercise: SAA-4.4-S05
scenario: Ravenscar Map Publishing's data-transfer charges rose 70 percent in a quarter with no growth in users, and the only reporting the team has is service-level totals in its cost tool. After a week of VPC flow logs, the extra bytes split three ways: 58 percent leave to internet viewers as repeat downloads of about 2,500 unchanging map-style and font files served from the application servers; 27 percent cross between the three Availability Zones because servers in two of them reach the internet through a single NAT gateway in the third; and 15 percent is a nightly 3 TB copy to a second Region that its owner cannot justify, with no reader found. The static files change at most once a week.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Product accepts viewers seeing a changed static file up to 24 hours late
The application servers must stay in their current Region and three Availability Zones
Two engineers maintain the platform and may use AWS-native services only, with no new third-party tooling

rubric.label: Each of the three byte drivers in the flow-log findings is matched to a fix that removes that driver's transfer charge, and no fix is proposed for traffic the findings do not show
The record names the measurement to repeat after the changes and the cost line that should show the 70 percent rise reversing

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
